原标题: Claude Cowork 101: How to automate your workday without touching code | JJ Englert (Tenex)

Claude Cowork 101: How to automate your workday without touching code | JJ Englert (Tenex)

JJ Englert leads community enablement at Tenex. In this episode, JJ provides a complete zero-to-one tutorial on Claude Cowork, Anthropic’s desktop tool that sits between simple chat and full terminal-based coding.

Listen or watch on YouTube, Spotify, or Apple Podcasts.

你可以在 YouTube、Spotify 或 Apple Podcasts 上收听或观看本期节目。

What you’ll learn:

  • Why one-click connectors to Gmail, Slack, Notion, and Google Calendar unlock AI that actually does work instead of just suggesting it
  • How to analyze your sent emails to build a writing skill that perfectly matches your tone and style
  • The sub-advisory-board technique: spinning up three AI agents with different personas to review your work from multiple perspectives
  • How to set permissions for each connector so Claude only drafts (never sends) or always asks before taking action
  • The scheduled-task workflow that creates a morning debrief by reading your email, Slack, and calendar every day at 7:30 a.m.
  • Why projects with shared memory beat individual chat threads for consistent, high-quality AI outputs

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: Gemma 4 音频转录 MLX 实践
item.description:
标签: #语音转录 #MLX #Gemma

摘要: 本文介绍了在macOS上借助MLX框架与mlx-vlm库，使用Gemma 4 E2B多模态模型本地转录音频文件的方法，作者不仅提供了一条可直接运行的`uv`命令，还展示了对14秒语音片段的实测转录效果及存在的细微误差。

原标题: Gemma 4 audio with MLX

Gemma 4 audio with MLX

使用 MLX 运行 Gemma 4 音频转录

Thanks to atip from Rahim Nathwani, here's auv runrecipe for transcribing an audio file on macOS using the 10.28 GBGemma 4 E2B modelwith MLX andmlx-vlm:

感谢 Rahim Nathwani 分享的小技巧，以下是一个在 macOS 上使用 uv run 的命令示例，借助 10.28 GB 的 Gemma 4 E2B 模型、MLX 和 mlx-vlm 来转录音频文件：

uv run --python 3.13 --with mlx_vlm --with torchvision --with gradio \
  mlx_vlm.generate \
  --model google/gemma-4-e2b-it \
  --audio file.wav \
  --prompt "Transcribe this audio" \
  --max-tokens 500 \
  --temperature 1.0
Your browser does not support the audio element.

你的浏览器不支持音频元素。

I tried it onthis 14 second.wavfileand it output the following:

我在这一个 14 秒的 .wav 文件上做了尝试，Gemma 输出了以下内容：

This front here is a quick voice memo. I want to try it out with MLX VLM. Just going to see if it can be transcribed by Gemma and how that works.

这段音频的开头是一个快速的语音备忘录。我想用 MLX VLM 来试一下。看看它能否被 Gemma 转录，以及效果如何。

This front here is a quick voice memo. I want to try it out with MLX VLM. Just going to see if it can be transcribed by Gemma and how that works.

这段音频的开头是一个快速的语音备忘录。我想用 MLX VLM 来试一下。看看它能否被 Gemma 转录，以及效果如何。

(That was supposed to be "This right here..." and "... how well that works" but I can hear why it misinterpreted that as "front" and "how that works".)

（这里原本应该是 "This right here..." 和 "... how well that works"，但我能理解为什么模型会将其误听为 "front" 和 "how that works"。）

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 坎特里尔：论“懒惰”的危机
item.description:
标签: #LLM #编程 #懒惰 #抽象

摘要: Bryan Cantrill 指出，LLMs 因缺乏“懒惰”的美德而不惜堆砌代码，只会让系统愈发臃肿而非精进；这也恰恰反衬出人类因时间有限而追求简洁抽象的“懒惰”是何其珍贵。

原标题: Quoting Bryan Cantrill

Quoting Bryan Cantrill

The problem is that LLMs inherentlylack the virtue of laziness. Work costs nothing to an LLM. LLMs do not feel a need to optimize for their own (or anyone's) future time, and will happily dump more and more onto a layercake of garbage. Left unchecked, LLMs will make systems larger, not better — appealing to perverse vanity metrics, perhaps, but at the cost of everything that matters.As such, LLMs highlight how essential our human laziness is: our finite timeforcesus to develop crisp abstractions in part because we don't want to waste our (human!) time on the consequences of clunky ones.

问题在于，LLM（大语言模型）本质上缺乏懒惰的美德。工作对 LLM 而言毫无代价。LLM 不会感到有必要为自己（或任何人）的未来时间进行优化，它们会很乐意在一层垃圾蛋糕上不断堆砌。如果不加约束，LLM 会让系统变得更大，而非更好——或许能满足扭曲的虚荣指标（vanity metrics），但却以牺牲一切真正重要的东西为代价。因此，LLM 突显了我们人类懒惰的重要性：我们有限的时间迫使我们去开发清晰的抽象，部分原因就是我们不想把（人类的！）时间浪费在笨拙抽象所带来的后果上。

The problem is that LLMs inherentlylack the virtue of laziness. Work costs nothing to an LLM. LLMs do not feel a need to optimize for their own (or anyone's) future time, and will happily dump more and more onto a layercake of garbage. Left unchecked, LLMs will make systems larger, not better — appealing to perverse vanity metrics, perhaps, but at the cost of everything that matters.

问题在于，LLM 本质上缺乏懒惰的美德。工作对 LLM 而言毫无代价。LLM 不会感到有必要为自己（或任何人）的未来时间进行优化，它们会很乐意在一层垃圾蛋糕上不断堆砌。如果不加约束，LLM 会让系统变得更大，而非更好——或许能满足扭曲的虚荣指标（vanity metrics），但却以牺牲一切真正重要的东西为代价。

As such, LLMs highlight how essential our human laziness is: our finite timeforcesus to develop crisp abstractions in part because we don't want to waste our (human!) time on the consequences of clunky ones.

因此，LLM 突显了我们人类懒惰的重要性：我们有限的时间迫使我们去开发清晰的抽象（abstractions），部分原因就是我们不想把（人类的！）时间浪费在笨拙抽象所带来的后果上。

—Bryan Cantrill, The peril of laziness lost

——Bryan Cantrill，《The peril of laziness lost》（《失去的懒惰之险》）

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 探索新的 `servo` crate
item.description:
标签: #Servo #Rust #浏览器 #WebAssembly

摘要: Servo 团队发布了可嵌入的 `servo` crate，开发者利用其构建了网页截图工具，并研究了编译为 WebAssembly 的可行性（发现直接编译不可行，但实现了相关 HTML 解析器的 WASM 版本）。

原标题: Exploring the new `servo` crate

Research: Exploring the new servo crate

Servo is now available on crates.io. The Servo team announced the initial release of the servo crate, which packages their browser engine as an embeddable library.

Servo 现已上架 crates.io。Servo 团队宣布了 servo crate（软件包）的初始版本，该版本将他们的浏览器引擎打包为一个可嵌入的库。

I set Claude Code the task of figuring out what it can do, building a CLI tool for taking screenshots using it and working out if it could be compiled to WebAssembly.

我给 Claude Code 布置了一项任务：弄清楚它能做什么，用它构建一个用于截图的 CLI（命令行界面）工具，并研究它是否可以编译为 WebAssembly（WebAssembly）。

The servo-shot Rust tool it built works pretty well:

它构建的 servo-shot Rust 工具运行得相当不错： 

git clone https://github.com/simonw/research
cd research/servo-crate-exploration/servo-shot
cargo build
./target/debug/servo-shot https://news.ycombinator.com/
Here's the result:

结果如下：

Compiling Servo itself to WebAssembly is not feasible due to its heavy use of threads and dependencies like SpiderMonkey, but Claude did build me this playground page for trying out a WebAssembly build of the html5ever and markup5ever_rcdom crates, providing a tool for turning fragments of HTML into a parse tree.

由于 Servo 大量使用了线程以及 SpiderMonkey 等依赖项，将其本身编译为 WebAssembly 是不可行的，但 Claude 确实为我构建了一个 playground（试验场）页面，用于试用 html5ever 和 markup5ever_rcdom crate 的 WebAssembly 构建版本，提供了一个将 HTML 片段转换为解析树的工具。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 史蒂夫·耶格如是说
item.description:
标签: #谷歌 #AI采用 #工程组织

摘要: Steve Yegge指出，谷歌工程团队的AI采用率并非领先，而是与约翰迪尔等普通企业相仿，呈现“20%高级用户、20%拒绝者、60%仅使用聊天工具”的行业典型分布；加之长达18个月的招聘冻结阻断了外部人才流入，使谷歌缺乏外部视角来意识到自身工程组织已变得多么平庸和落后。

原标题: Quoting Steve Yegge

引用 Steve Yegge

The TL;DR is that Google engineering appears to have the same AI adoption footprint as John Deere, the tractor company. Most of the industry has the same internal adoption curve: 20% agentic power users, 20% outright refusers, 60% still using Cursor or equivalent chat tool. It turns out Google has this curve too. [...]There has been an industry-wide hiring freeze for 18+ months, during which time nobody has been moving jobs. So there are no clued-in people coming in from the outside to tell Google how far behind they are, how utterly mediocre they have become as an eng org.

简而言之，Google 工程团队的 AI 采用状况似乎与拖拉机公司 John Deere（约翰迪尔）别无二致。大多数公司的内部采用曲线都是如此：20% 的 agentic（具备自主行动能力的）高级用户，20% 的彻底拒绝者，还有 60% 仍在使用 Cursor 或类似的聊天工具。事实证明，Google 也遵循着这条曲线。[...] 全行业已实施招聘冻结超过 18 个月，在此期间没有人跳槽。因此，没有来自外部的知情者告诉 Google 他们已经落后了多少，作为一个 eng org（工程组织），他们已经变得多么平庸。
